messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx + stream disconnects for /v1/stream and /v1/generate across gateway nodes in us-west-2. Error rate 12% over baseline, client cancels up 8%. Paging fanout queries show elevated latencies. Paging/gateway correlation flagged. auto-escalation -> oncall.
michelle: ack. I’m oncall. seeing lots of 502/504 from gateway. stack traces show upstream read timeout from runtime-proxy. examples in logs: `upstream timed out (110: Operation timed out) while reading response header from upstream`.
devin: I’m looking at ingress metrics. Gateway CPU not saturated but connection count spiked. Looks like many clients are cancelling mid-stream which leaves partial chunked frames in the gateway and triggers retries.
allen: any recent deploys or config changes? I pushed a routing tweak an hour ago to enable fast-fanout for paging; rolling back now as an experiment.
michelle: rolling back fast-fanout flag on gateway pool-3. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/gateway FAST_FANOUT=false -n prod`.
allen: rollback started.
tanvi: adding verbose logs on proxy: `nginx: log_format streaming_debug ...` so we can see chunk boundaries and client cancel codes. also increasing gateway idle_timeout from 30s -> 90s to avoid early tears while we triage.
michelle: customers impacted: about 14 tenants with high streaming usage (chat widgets). Surface impact: partial messages, reconnect loops, client-side `ERR_STREAM_RESET` and increased token charges for clients that retry.
sarah: digging into runtime nodes. The runtime reports `KV cache write contention` and repeated `broken pipe` on some model containers. Could be cascade from client cancels + aggressive retries.
devin: mitigation plan proposal:
- short term (live): disable streaming for affected tenants -> fallback to paged (non-chunked) responses to avoid chunk boundary corruption. feature flag: `STREAMING_FALLBACK=on` per-tenant.
- infra: increase gateway idle/timeouts and pause autoscale for runtime-proxy to avoid noisy autoscale churn.
- app: revert fast-fanout (done), add 429 backpressure if client cancel rate > 5%.
michelle: implement short term now. @tanvi can you roll the per-tenant flag? I'll coordinate customer comms.
tanvi: applying flag for 14 tenants: `redwoodctl tenants set-flag --tenants $(cat impacted.txt) --flag streaming_fallback=on`.
ops-bot: ACTION: Oncall michelle assigned. Incident severity: Sev2. Pager duty notified. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-7890 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: @michelle acknowledged. If unresolved in 60m, escalate to @devin.
michelle: doing live mitigation now. setting throttles and enabling fallback. will report back in 15.
allen: noticed increase in gateway 502s corresponds to a specific edge node (gw-7). Taking gw-7 out of LB rotation: `k8s cordon gw-7 && kubectl scale deployment/gateway-7 --replicas=0`.
devin: telemetry after rollback shows 5xx down from 12% -> 6% in 8m. Client cancels still at +3%, but streaming payload errors reduced. Looks promising.
tanvi: streaming_fallback applied for all affected tenants. Confirmed they now receive paged responses.
michelle: customer impact assessment: 14 tenants had interruptions (chat partial replies), 3 tenants reported customer-facing errors. No data loss. Estimated user-facing error window ~28m (start->mitigation).
sarah: collecting logs and sample request ids for postmortem: save these traces: `trace: 0f3a2c`, `trace: e9b1f0`, `trace: 4d2b7a`.
michelle: handoff to @tanvi for next hour for stabilization and follow-up. Please maintain mitigation and look for recurrence. I’ll draft incident summary and notify Support + CS.
tanvi: acknowledged. I’ll run a full health scan across all gateway pools and schedule a runbook walkthrough.
michelle: post-incident actions (prelim):
- root cause: interaction between fast-fanout routing + client cancel spikes causing partial chunked frames -> runtime retries -> KV contention -> cascade.
- short-term fix: per-tenant streaming fallback + increased idle_timeout + gateway node rotation.
- medium-term: add end-to-end idempotency for streams, more robust chunk boundary handling in gateway, backpressure and better retry logic in runtime.
- owner for postmortem: sarah (eng-runtime) and allen (eng-platform) to co-author.
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigated): 5xx back to baseline, client cancels reduced. Severity de-escalated to Sev3. Closing alert in 2h if stable.
michelle: thanks team. follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:00 PST to review postmortem TODOs. :white_check_mark:
